summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing commercial partnerships and product expansions, not a special situation. The press release details a cooperation agreement with Shanghai Singapore International School to deploy its AI-powered CEPA platform and the launch of a Portuguese proficiency assessment system with an MOU with the University of Évora. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine business update.
